title: Quiet
text: Quiet. This little unit is very nice and quiet. Easy to fill and clean.

product_metadata.title: 6L Humidifiers for Large Room, Mist Humidifiers for Bedroom Top Fill Humidifier with Essential Oil Diffuser, 360° Rotation Nozzle, 3 Mist Levels Lasts Up to 30 Hours, Auto Shut-Off, Whisper Quiet
features: 6L Humidifiers For Bedroom --- 6L/1.6 gallon extra-large water tank ensures up to 45 hours continuous working time, which is perfect for bedroom, baby room, office, and so on. Ultra-quiet at 23 decibels, no annoying working sound. Our cool mist humidifier should be a great choice for light sleep person and who have kids, pets.

Quiet & Long Lasting Mist Output --- 3 adjustable long lasting mist levels(Low/Medium/High), you can enjoy the option to change the mist setting and timer setting. The humidifiers can be automatically auto-off with red indicator light flashing when it is out of water or remove the tank away. 1-12 hours timer setting is more convenient for your use.

Top Fill Humidifier Easy To Clean --- KONFORSMAR top-fill humidifier is incredibly convenient to refill and clean than traditional humidifiers. It's features a detachable water tank with a secure built-in handle and an extra wide opening for easy filling and clean the inside of the tank. Built-in advanced water level sensor, auto shut off when water is running out, preventing damage to the humidifier and ensure your safety.

Easy To Use With Voice Control --- KONFORSMAR cool mist humidifier can be simply connect with the APP through 2.4GHz Wi-Fi for remote control. It features schedules to automatically turn on/off the humidifier as your schedule, which lets you enjoy a comfortable space. Before running setup, please allow all applications for mobile phone function permissions.

Humidifiers With Essential Oil Tray --- Equipped with replaceable ceramic filter to purifies can keeps the water fresh & prevents odour. And our humidifiers comes with a essential oil tray that you add some favorite essential oils to the tray before turning on the humidifier, and you will enjoy a unique and relaxing aromatherapy experience! Please DO NOT add essential oil directly to the water tank, avoid damaging the machine.
